title: Strength and hypertrophy
learning_outcomes: Explain strength and size in the context of strength and hypertrophy.
Compare and distinguish load and volume in the context of strength and hypertrophy.
Apply recovery in the context of strength and hypertrophy.
Evaluate and justify decisions about progression in the context of strength and hypertrophy.

lessons.title: Strength and size
lessons.outcome: Explain strength and size in the context of strength and hypertrophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving strength and size; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional training log.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain strength and size from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of strength and size; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Load and volume
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish load and volume in the context of strength and hypertrophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving load and volume; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional training log.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain load and volume from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of load and volume; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Recovery
lessons.outcome: Apply recovery in the context of strength and hypertrophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving recovery; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional training log.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain recovery from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of recovery; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Progression
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about progression in the context of strength and hypertrophy.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving progression; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional training log.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain progression from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of progression; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of strength and size; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of load and volume; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of recovery; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of progression; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
